quote: We know truth, not only by the reason, but also by the heart, and it is in this last way that we know first principles; and reason, which has no part in it, tries in vain to impugn them.
source: Blaise Pascal, Pensées, Section IV, Of the Means of Belief, no. 282 (trans. W. F. Trotter, 1910)
